title: Broncos think Jaylen Waddle's big day "only the tip of the iceberg"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos think Jaylen Waddle's big day "only the tip of the iceberg"
sources.description: The Broncos traded for wide receiver Jaylen Waddle this offseason in order to add more explosiveness to their offense, but Waddle wasn't able to make a difference in their Week 1 loss to the Chiefs.
